_comment: Provenance for WASM bundles built from the pqctoday-hsm repo and vendored into this hub. When you rebuild a bundle with its hsm build script, update its `hsmCommit`/`builtAt`. Verify drift with `npm run sync:wasm:check` (compares against a sibling ../pqctoday-hsm checkout when present; no-op otherwise). Bundles built from other sources (openssl upstream, pqctoday-tpm) are intentionally omitted.

bundles.name: cacp-kmip
bundles._buildNote: Rebuilt from pqctoday-hsm v0.14.0 (this entry was stale: hub commit 2ae5cc16/#409 had already rebuilt this bundle from v0.13.1 without updating this manifest — real remaining drift was 2 commits, not 23). Picks up CKA_ALLOWED_MECHANISMS (§4.8 Table 13) engine-side enforcement, CKO_CERTIFICATE (§4.6, X.509-only) with KMIP-certificate-to-engine projection via Register/Import, and the same day's gap-remediation pass (mechanism-mismatch regression fix, Register/Certify certificate parity, 6 class-blind CKA_ID lookups, C_CopyObject CKA_TRUSTED/identity-respoofing fix, CKA_ALLOWED_MECHANISMS length validation, certificate-projection observability). Correction (2026-07-10): does NOT pick up the 'Re-certify CKA_ID-collision fix' — verified that fix (kmip/src/ops/certify.rs `recertify()`, the explicit destroy-old-engine-object-before-registering-new step) is inline in the native-only `certify` module and has no wasm-reachable equivalent; Certify/Re-certify remain `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`-gated and answer `OperationNotSupported` in this wasm build, same as before this rebuild. Register/Import's own certificate projection (the part that IS wasm-reachable) has no equivalent collision-avoidance either, in native or wasm — a real, pre-existing, separate gap, out of scope for today's fix. Required an hsm-side fix first: `certify::project_certificate_to_engine` was called unconditionally from `register_import_export.rs` (Register/Import), but the `certify` module is `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`-gated (its CSR/rcgen-based issuance logic doesn't cross-compile to wasm32) — the wasm32 build had never actually been attempted since certificate support was added, so this had been silently broken. Fixed by extracting the wasm-safe projection helper into its own always-compiled `cert_projection` module (hsm branch `fix/kmip-wasm-cert-projection-gate`, not yet merged to hsm main as of this build — needs its own follow-up PR on the hsm side). Full in-wasm smoke test passed: real ML-DSA-65 CreateKeyPair/Sign/Verify roundtrip and hybrid KEM (X25519MLKEM768) encapsulate/decapsulate, both executing inside the wasm engine.

bundles.name: softhsmrustv3-engine
bundles._buildNote: Rebuilt from pqctoday-hsm v0.14.0 (was genuinely 10 commits / ~7 functional behind — this manifest entry was accurate, unlike cacp-kmip's). Picks up: Split Key secret-sharing math + handle-based native API, HSS/LMS wired into native::sign + Register-import, the v0.13.0 gap-remediation audit fixes (Destroy scrubbing, attribute-mutation honesty, RSA-Register/Encrypt-Decrypt/Locate fixes), and the same day's PKCS#11 v3.2 gap-remediation pass (CKA_ALLOWED_MECHANISMS mechanism-mismatch fix, CKO_CERTIFICATE, Register/Certify parity, Re-certify collision fix, class-blind CKA_ID lookups, C_CopyObject trust gate, mechanism-length validation). Still built with --features acvp (required since 2026-06-27 for ACVP KAT seeding). Binary grew from 2,209,912 to 2,885,179 bytes (~30%), consistent with the real new compiled surface (FrodoKEM/Classic McEliece were already in this bundle from the prior build).

bundles.name: softhsm-cpp-engine
bundles._buildNote: Includes fix(cpp) 250994d: SP800-108 KDF now requires keyed-MAC PRF (CKM_SHA256_HMAC); bare hash IDs rejected per PKCS#11 v3.2 §6.42.
